info.syllabusName: Quản trị sản phẩm và thương hiệu (Product and Branding Management)
info.description:
Knowledge and understanding theories the basic
knowledge of (1) framework; (2) analytical skills for branding decisions; and
(3) a focus on branding decisions. Besides, the course also provides knowledge
for designing, implementing, building, measuring and managing brand equity as
well as methodologies to measure, maintain, and develop brand over time and
geographic boundaries.
﻿
info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU

clos.loDetails: Understand basic knowledge about brand and various functions of brand management
Apply knowledge of branding concepts to branding practice.
Analyze branding techniques and apply them to a variety of different issues
Evaluate marketing programs to design and implement brand strategies.
Manage brands over time and geographic boundaries
